001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004import java.awt.Dimension;
005import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
006import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
007
008import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
009import javax.swing.BoxLayout;
010import javax.swing.JButton;
011import javax.swing.JFrame;
012import javax.swing.JLabel;
013import javax.swing.JPanel;
014import javax.swing.UIManager;
015import javax.swing.border.Border;
016
017/**
018 * Represents the Swing GUI quit menu.
019 */
020public class GUIQuitMenu extends JFrame {
021    /**
022     * Default dimensions of the quit confirmation window.
023     */
024    private static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(450, 250);
025
026    /**
027     * Title of the quit confirmation window.
028     */
029    private static final String TITLE = "Exit DayPlanner";
030
031    /**
032     * Window close operation: do nothing on default close so user must choose an option button.
033     */
034    private static final int CLOSE = JFrame.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE;
035
036    /**
037     * Background color for the quit confirmation window.
038     */
039    private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(222, 153, 153);
040
041    /**
042     * Padding border applied around panels in the quit window.
043     */
044    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
045
046
047    /**
048     * Create a new Swing GUI quit menu.
049     * 
050     * @param gdp Refers to the Swing GUI menu.
051     */
052    public GUIQuitMenu(GUIDayPlanner gdp) {
053        // ==============================
054        // Window Setup
055        // ==============================
056
057        super();
058        setSize(DIMS);
059        setTitle(TITLE);
060        setDefaultCloseOperation(CLOSE);
061        getContentPane().setBackground(BACKGROUND);
062        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
063        setLayout(new BoxLayout(getContentPane(), BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
064
065
066        // ==============================
067        // Warning
068        // ==============================
069
070        String warningText = "<html>"
071            + "Are you sure you want to exit DayPlanner?<br>"
072            + "This will save your list to disk."
073            + "</html>";
074
075        JLabel warningLabel = new JLabel(warningText);
076        warningLabel.setIcon(UIManager.getIcon("OptionPane.warningIcon"));
077        warningLabel.setIconTextGap(24);
078        warningLabel.setBorder(PADDING);
079
080        JPanel labelPanel = new JPanel();
081        labelPanel.setOpaque(false);
082        labelPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
083        labelPanel.add(warningLabel);
084        add(labelPanel);
085
086
087        // ==============================
088        // Buttons
089        // ==============================
090
091        ActionListener buttonEvent = new ActionListener() {
092            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
093                dispose();
094                if (event.getActionCommand().equals("CLOSE"))
095                    gdp.quit();
096            }
097        };
098        
099        JButton closeButton = new JButton("YES - Save and exit");
100        closeButton.setActionCommand("CLOSE");
101        closeButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
102
103        JButton cancelButton = new JButton("NO - Do not exit");
104        cancelButton.setActionCommand("CANCEL");
105        cancelButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
106
107        JPanel buttonPanel = new JPanel();
108        buttonPanel.setOpaque(false);
109        buttonPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
110        buttonPanel.add(closeButton);
111        buttonPanel.add(cancelButton);
112        add(buttonPanel);
113
114
115        // ==============================
116        // End
117        // ==============================
118
119        setVisible(true);
120    }
121}
